message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data from the database, config, or command-line arguments at any point in the data-acquisition flow.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from a local MongoDB instance with no checksum verification, authentication tokens, or integrity checks on the retrieved records.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to the training samples at any point in the data preparation pipeline.
No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models via dill and network.load_model() without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before use.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the training code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: The evaluation only computes accuracy and a classification report using sklearn; no adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are present.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although split_dataset is called to separate train/test/validation, the evaluation results are simply written to a plain text file with no signing, hashing, or independent verification mechanism, and the random test samples via get_random are not isolated or tracked in a tamper-evident way.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (get_random → data_generation → classify) performs no shape, range, or schema validation on inputs before passing them to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: While binarize is applied to predictions, there are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or out-of-range checks on the model's raw outputs before or after binarization.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio genre classification model (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
